ES-001.note: Typed source diagnostics are defined; decoding the source raster arrives with the Qt Gui editor surface.

ES-002.note: Canvas coordinates are source pixels with a top-left origin. Orientation, alpha, and colour normalization arrive with the source loader.

ES-004.note: Selection, move, and delete exist in EditorSession. Visible selection, resize, rotate, ordering, and pointer and keyboard handling arrive with the editor UI.

ES-006.note: Undo and redo restore the selection each state had (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp).

ES-007.note: History states are value snapshots; embedded images are implicitly shared and never mutated or disposed while reachable.

ES-008.note: Gesture cancellation and the Save, Discard, Cancel close prompt arrive with the editor UI.

ES-009.note: AnnotationRenderer is the authoritative export compositor. Encoding the requested format and colour profile arrives with the save path.

ES-011.note: EditorSession::recordSave() marks clean only when the raster and sidecar both persisted (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp). Atomic raster replacement arrives with the save path.

ES-012.note: A sidecar failure keeps the session dirty and reports sidecar-save-failed (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp).

ES-013.note: gzip-wrapped UTF-8 JSON with the schema fields round-trips (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp). Computing the source SHA-256 arrives with the source loader.

ES-016.note: The source-hash mismatch choice arrives with the editor UI.

ES-017.note: Strict base64, PNG signature and IHDR limits, duplicate IDs, and finite numbers are checked before decode (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp).

ES-020.note: Temp and recovery retention arrive with the save path and recovery.

ES-022.note: Structural and history vectors pass. Shared golden-image vectors await approved fixtures.

ES-025.note: Multiple-of-90 rotations follow the reference exactly; other rotations return UnsupportedRotation until exact polygon coverage is implemented.

ES-028.note: Canvas and embedded-image limits are checked from JSON and PNG headers; readXann stops inflating at the JSON byte limit (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp).

ES-029.note: Document diagnostics follow the required priority and sidecar-save-failed and raster-save-failed are reported; the source-* diagnostics arrive with the source loader.

ES-030.note: The baseline fallback convention still needs runtime observation before activation, as ES-030 requires.
